description.value:
You learn to build and bond with a portable turret companion, created following the rules for companions in the Customization Options document for Expanded Content; you must have artillerist's implements to build it.

Beyond its usual traits and features, your bonded turret gains these additional benefits:

  • It is a valid target for the tracker droid interface tech power.
  • It gains two extra traits, plus one more at 11th level. Each trait beyond your proficiency bonus reduces your tech point maximum by 1. During a long rest, you may install, swap, or remove a number of traits equal to half your Intelligence modifier (rounded up, minimum 1).
  • You may let your turret make a weapon attack in place of one you would make.

Additionally, while your turret is bonded, within 10 feet of you, and marked by your tracker droid interface tech power, you can cast a tech power with a range of 5 feet or more as though you occupied your turret's space, with the range extended to at least 10 feet. Both this range and the earlier 10-foot proximity requirement grow to 30 feet at 11th level and 60 feet at 17th level.
